svg.title: Recommended configuration
svg.desc: Three tiers. Minimum: Windows 10/11 x64, no GPU, 16 GB RAM, about 25 GB free; Qwen3-4B on CPU with an 8k context, 1 OCR worker, about 90 seconds per page. Recommended: Windows 11, an NVIDIA GPU with 8 GB or more, 32 GB RAM, SSD; Qwen3-4B on GPU with a 16k context, 1 OCR worker, about 20 seconds per page. Best: Windows 11, an NVIDIA GPU with 16 to 24 GB, 32 to 64 GB RAM, NVMe SSD; Qwen3-8B on GPU with a 16k context, 2 OCR workers, about 7.8 seconds per page.
